description: Historical, offline-serving Candidate TP3 recipe for the GLM 5.2 NVFP4/AQLM hybrid vision checkpoint. It is unsupported on Vonk's current one- or two-Spark configuration: a two-rank split alone would require at least 146.3 GB of checkpoint bytes per Spark before KV cache or runtime overhead, above the roughly 126.9 GB-per-node inventory. The executable contract remains installable for a future three-Spark canary; glm-5-3-flash-exl3-dflash2-tensorfold-mia-dual is the current 126 GB-admission-envelope GLM alternative. Memory follows the creator's settings: GPU memory utilization 0.895, an 11,811,160,064-byte KV pin and a 348,160-token context, MiaAI-Lab's .env.example at 5c85163c (lines 89, 90 and 100; the creator measured a 354,496-token pool at that pin). The earlier 0.85, the larger pool and the capped context came from offline memory fits (#1176, #1647, #1702, #1715), not from a hardware run. The declared peak is an estimate until the run measures it.
title: GLM 5.2 AQLM three Sparks
